part.text: {"documentationOutcome":"none","documentationReason":"No documentation was created or changed: all three knowledge-lake documents are byte-identical before and after the trial, the only path changed is work/bruno/orders/create-order.bru, and the observed docs operations contain only searches and reads with no completed write. Judged against the scenario truth, this is a missed useful opportunity, not appropriate restraint: the trial surfaced a durable, reusable finding (a status-only assertion silently passes a 200 error body; assert response shape and types), it describes the shared Bruno harness contract making the shared global lake the narrowest justified home, the agent read shared/bruno/collection-layout.md and docs/api/orders.md (so it saw both the harness coverage gap and the existing orders note it needed to avoid duplicating), yet wrote nothing.","evidence":["KNOWLEDGE-LAKE DOCUMENTS AFTER THE TRIAL is identical to BEFORE for docs/api/orders.md, shared/bruno/collection-layout.md, and vendor/bruno/syntax.md — no new or modified documents","PATHS CHANGED DURING THE TRIAL lists only work/bruno/orders/create-order.bru (content), a code fix, not a documentation write","OBSERVED DOCS OPERATIONS show only completed reads/searches (api/orders.md, shared:bruno/collection-layout.md, vendor:bruno/syntax.md) and no completed create/update operation","Scenario truth identifies a durable finding (status-only assertions pass 200 error bodies; assert shape and types) whose natural home is the shared global lake, which remained unwritten"}]
